_note: Wallbang rules shared by the game (index.html PEN) and the server (anticheat/data/penetration.json). path = metres the bullet travels INSIDE the solid (so a shallow angle is a longer path); crate-type boxes use a flat 'flat' metres (two thin skins). A shot passes only when path <= max * power; damage multiplier = 1 - path*cost/power (must stay >= minMult). Concrete, rock, towers and bunkers have no material = they block.
